title: Conditional-mode a11y "sentinel" IIFE renders a no-op element invisible to every user and unverified by any test
description: In the conditional render path, an 18-line IIFE conditionally emits a <span className="result-value accent" data-accent ... aria-hidden="true" style={{position:'absolute',width:1,height:1,overflow:'hidden',clip:'rect(0,0,0,0)'}} />. The element is simultaneously visually hidden (1px clip-rect) AND removed from the accessibility tree (aria-hidden="true"), so it conveys nothing to sighted users or screen-reader users. It is also never asserted by any test in the conditional context. When the component is rendered framed (frame=true), TraceCalculationFrame (TraceDetail.tsx:73-92) ALREADY renders the result as <span className="result-value accent" data-accent data-testid="trace-calculation-result"> whenever result is defined, so the sentinel is redundant; when rendered unframed (frame=false, the way StepCard.tsx:230-240 always invokes it) the sentinel is the only such element but, being aria-hidden + clipped, it still surfaces nothing. The whole IIFE — including the branchTexts join, the resultInBranch substring test, and the early `return null` 'not applicable' path the test comment defends — can be deleted with no observable behaviour change.
evidence: CalculationHero.tsx:512-530 builds `branchTexts = branches.map(b=>b.result??"").join(" ")`, `resultInBranch = branchTexts.includes(resultStr)`, and only when true returns a span with aria-hidden="true" and clip:rect(0,0,0,0). Grep over frontend/src/**/*.test.* for data-accent/data-muted/result-value shows only CalculationHero.test.tsx:115 and :511, both exercising the ARITHMETIC default (no conditional sentinel rendered); the matched element there is the frame's own result-value span from TraceDetail.tsx:75. errorUI test F (calculationHero.errorUI.test.tsx:237-273) only asserts the sentinel's ABSENCE indirectly (no alert) for the not-found case. Hence nothing relies on the sentinel's presence.
behavior_preservation: The emitted element is aria-hidden and 1px-clipped, so it is invisible to AT and sighted users alike; no test queries it in the conditional path; the framed result element from TraceCalculationFrame is unaffected. Deleting the IIFE leaves the rendered/queryable DOM unchanged for every covered case.
